title: R Alice
subtitle: 65 keys in two angled halves on the R GRID board
context: Personal project. A design, not built.
role: Direction and design, with AI tools for the drawings and renders
summary: R Alice is one of four keyboards in the R GRID series, designed in 2026. My Alice layout on one board whose outline follows the two halves, each turned about 12 degrees.

sections.heading: The board
sections.body: My Alice layout on one board whose outline follows the two halves, each turned about 12 degrees. It is built like the rest of the series: a black board printed with the grid, low keycaps, a frosted white base, and blue for the spacers and feet.

sections.heading: From the side
sections.body: From the desk up: a frosted base and frame with brass nuts set into it, a white circuit board, blue spacers and the black board. The feet are clear blue pieces held by cross bolts.
